narrative.headline: Top 50 tilts constructive but split — 25 tickers bullish/lean bullish vs 24 bearish/lean bearish, with mega-cap tech and financials leading accumulation while Alphabet and defensives get distributed.
bullish_setups: JPM: perfect 10.0 composite — flow, dark pool ($1.75B), and blocks all maxed, cleanest bull setup on the board
NVDA: $35.7M call premium (flow 8.8) stacked on $1.26B dark pool and max block conviction
AAPL: $22.5M call premium + $1.55B dark pool — institutions loading through every channel
META: $36.4M flow premium (largest on board) with $440M dark pool amplifier
MSFT: $29.9M call premium + $726M dark pool confirms mega-cap tech accumulation theme
XOM/CVX: energy majors both scoring 8.4+ with strong flow and dark pool — sector-level positioning
C: $326M dark pool + max blocks amplify financials theme alongside JPM
KLAC: semis cap-ex play with 10.0 dark pool and 9.86 blocks
TSLA: $32.4M call premium confirms retail-favorite still getting institutional bid
KO/PEP: consumer staples divergence — both bullish while PG gets sold
bearish_setups: GOOG/GOOGL: both Alphabet classes bearish (flow 4.14/3.51) despite maxed dark pool — put premium dominating structurally
ORCL: flow 3.23 — put-heavy despite $9.3 dark pool conviction, sellers using size
PG: flow 2.86 — staples name being distributed while KO/PEP accumulated
AXP/MS: financials cross-current — put flow on consumer credit and IB while JPM/C get bid
MRK: flow 3.35 with high dark pool magnitude signals conviction distribution
MU: flow 2.88 — semis divergence, sold while KLAC/NVDA bought
GE: weakest composite at 1.59, flow 2.08 — clearest single-name bearish setup
narrative.rotation_signal: Accumulation concentrated in mega-cap tech (NVDA, AAPL, MSFT, META), money-center banks (JPM, C), and energy (XOM, CVX); distribution hitting Alphabet, ORCL, PG, HD, and select financials (AXP, MS). Semi complex is bifurcated — KLAC/NVDA bid, MU sold — suggesting selective rather than sector-wide chip conviction.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: GOOG/GOOGL bearish read stands out given communications sector often prints bullish at industry layer; ORCL and MU bearishness may conflict with broader tech/semis positive tape; JPM vs MS/AXP split shows financials layer likely averages to neutral despite JPM's perfect score.
